question: Did v0.6.0 regress common Go/Python lifecycle latency versus v0.5.3?
action_informed: Decide whether a bounded regression diagnosis is warranted; no optimization is pre-authorized.
workloads: Go light/10MiB serial/10MiB four-worker Fresh/Fork; Python two-table small/medium prepared baseline with two children.
sampling: Six alternating pairs per common cell; one separate Go warmup pair; Python resource observation kept separate.
exit: Report raw distributions, phase timings, paired changes, correctness/cleanup outcomes and limits. No universal speed or memory claim. Any failure is retained and stops the campaign.
excluded: 100MiB, Windows/Linux claims, cold installation cost, new-feature versus nonexistent-old-feature comparisons, resource-model campaign.
